title: Answer: any creature with suitable higher-order states, open beyond humans

statements.text: Whatever has suitable higher-order representations of its own states has conscious states. Humans do. Infants, mammals, animals without a prefrontal cortex and robots are open questions, and an awake creature might have no conscious states at all.

sources.quote: it is open to find out whether they have at least some HOTs of the requisite kind
So there may well be creatures none of whose mental states are conscious, even when they are fully awake.
